notes: One of the classic solid "core" flavors from bloom. Solid start from the Bloom guys
body:
Started seeing bloom pop up on shelves mid last year, around summer 2025. I was skeptical at first with the health marketing and <200mg as I questioned why I'd take it over celsius. but decided to try them out starting with this flavor.

Overall taste: nice "subtle" mango flavor. They are definitely on the less sweet end of energy drinks. Due to this, they leave almost no dryness in your mouth. The mango peach flavor comes through nicely, and the aftertaste itself is very subtle. Because there is no dryness, it almost feels like you are drinking a slightly stronger La Croix with caffeine. I would say it's good, nothing extraordinary like some other peach/mango offerings from others, but plays well into the subtle taste/health marketing they have going on.

Overall experience: Very good, definitely marketed towards the broad population. Least likely to feel a rush of energy or jitters due to the L theanine, which is a positive for some. Generally a nice choice who want a good dose of caffeine without intense flavor, and who don't care about finding a very unique flavor experience in the core fruit flavor energy market.
name: Peach Mango
